NET-01.nist_description: Boundary Protection | Restrict Outgoing Communications | Implement Managed Interfaces
NET-01.cis_description: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
NET-01.pci_description: Restrict inbound and outbound traffic to only that which is necessary

NET-02.nist_description: Boundary Protection | Deny by Default | Information Flow Enforcement
NET-02.cis_description: Manage Firewall Rules | Network Traffic Filtering
NET-02.pci_description: Deny all traffic not explicitly allowed; restrict inbound/outbound

NET-03.nist_description: Malicious Code Protection | System Monitoring | Intrusion Detection
NET-03.cis_description: Deploy and Manage Anti-Malware Software | Network IDS/IPS
NET-03.pci_description: Protect all systems against malware; use IDS/IPS at critical points

NET-04.nist_description: Audit Events | Audit Record Generation | System Monitoring
NET-04.cis_description: Establish and Maintain an Audit Log Management Process
NET-04.pci_description: Implement audit logging to reconstruct security events

IAC-01.nist_description: Account Management | Least Privilege | Privileged Accounts
IAC-01.cis_description: Use Unique Passwords | Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
IAC-01.pci_description: Implement strong access control; manage user IDs and authentication

IAC-07.nist_description: Identification and Authentication | MFA for Privileged Accounts
IAC-07.cis_description: Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications and Admin Access
IAC-07.pci_description: MFA for all non-console access into the CDE; MFA for all admin access

IAC-09.nist_description: Account Management | Automated Audit Actions | Account Monitoring
IAC-09.cis_description: Establish and Maintain an Account Inventory | Periodic Access Reviews
IAC-09.pci_description: Review user accounts at least every 6 months; remove inactive accounts

LOG-01.nist_description: Event Logging | Content of Audit Records | Audit Record Generation
LOG-01.cis_description: Collect Audit Logs | Ensure Adequate Audit Log Storage
LOG-01.pci_description: Log all access to system components and cardholder data

LOG-02.nist_description: Protection of Audit Information | Audit Record Retention
LOG-02.cis_description: Ensure Adequate Audit Log Storage | Retain Audit Logs
LOG-02.pci_description: Retain audit logs for at least 12 months; at least 3 months available for analysis

CFG-01.nist_description: Baseline Configuration | Configuration Change Control | Configuration Settings
CFG-01.cis_description: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
CFG-01.pci_description: Develop configuration standards for all system components

CFG-02.nist_description: Configuration Change Control | Automated Change Tracking | Access Restrictions
CFG-02.pci_description: Implement change and configuration management processes

CFG-03.nist_description: Configuration Settings | Least Functionality | Cryptographic Protection
CFG-03.cis_description: Disable Unnecessary Services | Configure Trusted DNS Servers
CFG-03.pci_description: Protect all system components from known vulnerabilities; disable unnecessary functions

CHG-01.nist_description: Configuration Change Control | Security Impact Analysis | Access Restrictions
CHG-01.cis_description: Implement a Change Management Process | Perform Application Layer Filtering
CHG-01.pci_description: Manage security impacts of change; test before production deployment

VUL-01.nist_description: Risk Assessment | Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning | Flaw Remediation
VUL-01.cis_description: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans | Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
VUL-01.pci_description: Scan for vulnerabilities at least quarterly; remediate within defined SLA

CRY-01.nist_description: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity | Cryptographic Protection
CRY-01.cis_description: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit | Use Only Approved Cryptography
CRY-01.pci_description: Use strong cryptography for transmission of cardholder data; prohibit weak protocols

IRO-01.nist_description: Incident Handling | Incident Monitoring | Incident Reporting | System Monitoring
IRO-01.cis_description: Establish and Maintain a Security Incident Response Process
IRO-01.pci_description: Implement an incident response plan; be prepared to respond to a system breach
